reason: A read-only deployment security health-check plugin that inspects runtime and configuration facts and reports categorized findings with remediation recommendations.

summaries.zh: 对当前部署执行只读安全体检，检查凭据权限、进程环境、审批策略、遥测、网络暴露和沙箱状态并生成报告。
summaries.en: Runs a read-only security health check on the current deployment, inspecting credential permissions, process environment, approval policies, telemetry, network exposure, and sandbox status.

capabilities: Reads deployment facts from context and node services
Inspects credential file permissions and process environment variables
Checks permission, approval, telemetry, anonymous ID, LAN exposure, and sandbox settings
Produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL audit report with recommendations
